title: Smudge/stain on picnic blanket!
text: Smudge/stain on picnic blanket!. I was really looking forward to receiving this product, but right when I opened it, I saw this stain?smudge? mark, and the packaging definitely did not seem like a new product. That is very disappointing and unclean. The quality is all right, and the size is nice and big but the material is mediocre and the smudge stain is very disappointing.
